item.uncannyvoxel.desaturated_eye.toolti: The eye sees what the mirror hides.
Drop on a Sulfur-Glass Mirror to open the way.
item.uncannyvoxel.lumen_scalpel.tooltip1: Cuts through the Substrate's black fog.
item.uncannyvoxel.lumen_scalpel.tooltip2: Reveals invisible entities. Drains max health while held.
item.uncannyvoxel.lumen_scalpel.tooltip3: Sleeping restores health... but may trigger Bed Paralysis.
item.uncannyvoxel.tether_stake.tooltip1: Creates a 5-block safe zone. Geometry cannot shift inside.
item.uncannyvoxel.tether_stake.tooltip2: Leaving the radius causes violent uprooting.
block.uncannyvoxel.tether_stake.activate: Tether Stake activated. Safe zone established.
block.uncannyvoxel.tether_stake.deactiva: Tether Stake deactivated. Safe zone collapsed.
block.uncannyvoxel.tether_stake.occupied: Another player is tethered to this stake.
